label: EWSR1::FEV

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
FEV encodes an ETS-family transcription factor involved in serotonergic neuron differentiation.

The fusion links the EWSR1 amino-terminal transcriptional activation region to an ETS-family DNA-binding region, creating an oncogenic transcription factor that reprograms cell identity. EWSR1::FEV is a recognized Ewing sarcoma fusion.
